instrument: Virginia air permit structure for data center backup generators
summary: Backup generator permits are written as annual emissions tonnage and fuel throughput on a rolling 365-day average, not as hours of operation. Reporting states that so long as a generator stays under its permitted annual level there is no limit on how much it runs.

source.citation: Virginia Mercury, January 14 2026, on Tier II generator permitting

notes: Bears directly on how an exceedance occurs. A single extended outage can consume a substantial share of an annual allowance without any hourly limit being broken. In the Leesburg consent order the reported fuel throughput was approximately 1,190,000 gallons against a permit limit of 665,850, arising from a four-day outage.
confidence_note: No permit has been read. The structure is described from reporting on Virginia's regime and may not generalize to other states. Whether any hours-based condition also applies is NOT_CHECKED.
